listing.summary: Upstream route: UpstreamcollectionZIP/tar.gz includes cps2recomp-launcher plus per-game program. Choose own ROM set folder, thenPlay this game; launcher can update sharedruntime onlyaftergamesclose. Development make GAME build is separate. This target is Vampire Savior: The Lord of Vampire (CPS2 Japan970519 vsavj). Limits: Upstream only: Beta. Upstream claims fighting-game endings and newer beat-em-up first stages in scripted play; few machines/controllers tested. Exact sets mandatory. Workbook Street Fighter Alpha 2 row is not entire engine scope. Expand only actually documented supported games to game+implementation records, sharing acquisition; no blanket whole-board-family admission. Upstream platforms: Windows 10/11 x64, Linux x86-64/SteamOS, macOS 13+ Apple Silicon/Intel. Shared launcher plus game-specific programs. Original data: Own arcade ROM set CPS2 Japan970519 vsavj. CPS2 sets require their game key file; parent ROM ZIP must be adjacent if shared files are split. Other region/revision sets refused. VampireSaviorDefinitive specifically requires both vsavjJapan970519 and vsav2Japan970913. No separate general consoleBIOS input specified. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
